_about: Example of the study team's --manuscript-params file (JSON or YAML). Copy it outside the repository, fill it in, and pass it to reproduce_study.py --manuscript-params and to python -m omop_etl.manuscript_checks --params. Every value below is a placeholder; the package stores no names. Keys the package reads (0.36.0): title, authors (name, affiliation or affiliations, email, orcid, corresponding, role), irb_statement, consortium, consortium_short, funding, conflicts_of_interest (or coi), bmi_by_age_note, discharge_limitation_note.
title: Multi-Center Benchmark of Traditional Machine Learning Models for 30-Day Hospital Readmission Risk Prediction
